column1: # Allocations per call each hot-path benchmark may take (#2716).
# Columns: package, benchmark, allocs/op. scripts/bench-allocs.py check (the
# bench-allocs target, a verify step and a pull request job) runs each 200
# iterations three times and fails when the lowest allocs/op exceeds its row,
# or when a listed package declares a benchmark with no row. A change that
# adds an allocation on purpose updates its row in the same diff: the
# bench-allocs-update target rewrites this table from a run. ns/op is not
# here: it is tracked weekly (.github/workflows/bench-trend.yml), never gated.
